}}'''Maraconn''' was a [[High Lord]] of [[Tear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Maraconn}}

== Appearance ==
He had blue eyes and thin lips.

== Activities ==
===To Cairhien===
He was sent with the army of Tear to restore order to [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|4|21}}

=== Fealty ===
After the battle with the [[Shaido]] in [[Cairhien]], Maraconn, along with the High Lords [[Aracome]], [[Gueyam]], [[Hearne]], [[Simaan]] and [[Torean]], swore fealty to [[Rand al'Thor]].

He went with Rand when Rand tried to deal with the [[Illian]] rebels loyal to Lord Brend. He rode with Rand when Rand's forces attacked the invading [[Seanchan]] just outside Illian. He followed [[Semaradrid]] into the final assault on the Seanchan. It is assumed that he does not survive this battle.

== Viewing ==
[[Min]] had a viewing that Aracome, Maraconn and Gueyam were going to die bloody deaths in battle. This viewing has been fulfilled for all of them, with Maraconn dying in a battle with the [[Seanchan]].

In TWoTC it is stated instead that Maraconn died fighting in the [[Last Battle]].
